- Update only the canonical media source for the Inspire the Work section.
- Regenerate the Google Hosted export for `ai-course-building-resources`.
- Redeploy only the `digitalpresentation` Firebase Hosting target.
- Verify the live site and the live video asset after deploy.

- STAX startup reads succeeded, but the sidecar is still on an unrelated stale `ai-course-building-resources` reject prompt.
- The ELA ZIP exists, is about 14.6 MB, contains 225 entries, and has `imsmanifest.xml`.
- Manifest organization is `Modern Drama` with Introduction plus Lessons 1-7.
- Manifest lesson resources point to `modern_drama\modern_drama_unit_introduction.html`, `characteristics_of_modern_drama.html`, `a_streetcar_named_desire_unit_intro.html`, `Streetcar Information and overview.html`, `Introduction to Death of a Salesman.html`, `A Doll's House.html`, `writing_a_critical_analytical_response_to_texts.html`, and `car_samples.html`.
- The Brightspace lesson HTML is UTF-16 encoded, so the project build should decode defensively instead of relying on the existing UTF-8 importer path alone.
- Sampled lesson content includes modern drama goals, modern drama characteristics, Tennessee Williams research, Streetcar overview, Death of a Salesman links, A Doll's House links, Critical/Analytical Response guidance, and student writing samples.
- The FinLit source frame uses the dark sidebar, fixed top bar, Tailwind runtime, Hanken Grotesk / IBM Plex Sans / Work Sans fonts, green accent palette, routed course pages, lesson detail panels, readings/resources views, and simple in-page JavaScript.
- No project files were created because the brainstorming skill requires design approval before implementation.

- The requested ZIP is readable and contains a single active Modern Drama unit suitable for a first master frame.
- The appropriate new project slug should be `ela30-1-modern-drama`.
- The likely source-of-truth file for implementation should be `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/workspace/index.html`.
- The FinLit style and interaction model can be reused as the visual/behavioral base.

What is weak/provisional:
- The UI design helper script from the ui-ux-pro-max skill was not available at the expected path, so only its static guidance and the existing FinLit frame were used.
- No automated project tests were written yet because implementation has not started.
- STAX proof state remains polluted by an unrelated stale deploy task.

What is unverified:
- No new ELA project files exist yet.
- No browser screenshot or STAX visual proof exists for the future ELA frame.
- No import/verify/typecheck/build commands were run for the new project.

Risks:
- Using `incoming:refresh` blindly may choose the wrong HTML entrypoint or mishandle UTF-16 content, so the implementation should use a controlled extraction/import path for this ZIP.
- Running `studio:codex:auto` may re-trigger incoming watcher behavior and overwrite active workspace files if incoming state is not controlled.
- External links and source images need to be preserved or explicitly marked as reference-only.

One next action:
After user approval of the proposed design, create `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama` with a FinLit-style master lesson frame and run focused verification.
